solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Set sail, going out to receive country singer

indicators.note: the scrambled letters take another piece inside them
sails going out are being spread and shifted, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: Chad is a country in central Africa

explanation.surface: A ship sets sail and stops off to pick up a country-music star.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country singer' looks like one phrase, but 'country' is CHAD and only 'singer' defines. 'going out' turns SET SAIL into SA...ISTEL, which receives CHAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacha Distel was a French crooner and guitarist, famous as a popular vocalist.

clue.text: Write your name on letters for the director

parts.note: to sign something is to write your name on it
post is mail, letters

explanation.surface: Sign your name on the letters for the director's approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Director' suggests a film or company boss; here it is something that directs travellers.
explanation.definitionFit: A roadside fingerpost directs travellers the right way, so it is a director.

clue.text: Material attached to twig

parts.note: cotton is a fabric
on means attached to, as in a button on a coat

explanation.surface: Some fabric is fastened to a twig.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Twig' looks like a small branch but is the verb to understand.
explanation.definitionFit: To twig is informal for realising something, and so is the phrasal verb meaning to catch on.

clue.text: Musical heroine in Vienna not originally dancing

indicators.note: the remaining letters dance into a new order
the city is used without its opening letter

explanation.surface: A stage heroine performs in Vienna, though not at first a dancer.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping V leaves IENNA, which 'dancing' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Annie is the orphan title character of the Broadway show about Little Orphan Annie.

clue.text: One doesn't appreciate swimming in Tangier

indicators.note: the letters swim about into a different order

explanation.surface: Someone ungrateful is swimming in the waters off Tangier.
explanation.walkthrough: Tangier is a port city in Morocco.
explanation.definitionFit: An ungrateful person fails to show gratitude, so does not appreciate what is done for them.

clue.text: Novelist discarding first bit of excess baggage

indicators.note: a letter is thrown away from the novelist's name

parts.note: Anthony Trollope was a Victorian novelist

indicators.note: only the initial letter of the word is meant

explanation.surface: A writer travelling light leaves behind some excess luggage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Baggage' looks like luggage, matching 'excess baggage', but it is the dated insult for a disreputable woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Baggage and the answer are both old disparaging words for an immoral woman.

clue.text: Recreational vehicle for salt of the earth?

definitions.text: Recreational vehicle for salt of the earth?

parts.words: Recreational vehicle for salt of the earth?
parts.note: salt of the earth suggests honest folk, but literally it means salt flats, where wheeled sailing craft race

explanation.surface: A leisure vehicle for honest, decent people.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheeled sail-powered craft raced on beaches and dry salt flats is a recreational vehicle.

clue.text: Drain starts in St Albans, ending in Ruislip

indicators.note: the opening letters of each of the two words of the town name are taken
only the final letter of the London suburb is taken

explanation.surface: A drainage job begins in St Albans and finishes in Ruislip.
explanation.walkthrough: St Albans is a city north of London and Ruislip a suburb in west London.
explanation.definitionFit: To sap strength is to drain it away gradually; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Creator of web page, drunk, dries out

indicators.note: the letters are tipsy and stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A web-page designer, drunk, sobers up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Web page' suggests the internet, but 'Creator of web' is the definition and 'page' is P.
explanation.definitionFit: An arachnid spins a web, so it is the maker of the web.

clue.text: Temple of a deity in Pennsylvania?

indicators.note: the deity goes inside the state's abbreviation

parts.note: PA is the postal abbreviation for Pennsylvania
a god is a deity

explanation.surface: Is there a temple to some god in Pennsylvania?
explanation.definitionFit: A pagoda is a tiered Buddhist or Hindu tower used as a temple.

clue.text: What boarders do in good school

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: Boarding pupils at a fine school are getting along well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boarders' suggests pupils at a boarding school like Eton, but here they are passengers boarding a bus or train.
explanation.definitionFit: Passengers boarding a vehicle climb aboard it, which is the phrasal verb meant.

clue.text: Punishment by parent in basic training

definitions.meaning: keeping a child at home as a penalty
a thorough schooling in the fundamentals of a subject

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both confining a child indoors as a penalty and an education in fundamentals.

clue.text: Buzz Lightyear's first seen after Enoch arranged to take friend out

indicators.note: the next piece is placed following the rest
the friend takes the shuffled letters inside

parts.note: pal is an informal word for friend

indicators.note: the name's letters are arranged into a new order
only the initial letter of the toy spaceman's name is used

explanation.surface: A toy astronaut appears after Enoch plans to take a pal on an outing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Buzz Lightyear' reads as the Toy Story character, but 'Buzz' alone is the definition; 'out' just completes the picture of an outing.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving someone a buzz is informal slang for ringing them on the telephone.

clue.text: Return to render

definitions.meaning: the profit an investment gives back
to give up or hand over, as in surrender

explanation.definitionFit: An investment's yield is its return, and to yield something is to render or surrender it.

clue.text: The cost of keeping soldiers in step

indicators.note: the soldiers are placed inside the step

parts.note: a stage is a step in a process
OR stands for other ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Keeping soldiers marching in step comes at a price.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In step' suggests marching, but 'step' is STAGE, holding OR.
explanation.definitionFit: Warehouses charge a fee for keeping goods, and that fee is called the charge for depositing items.

clue.text: One way to refer to rising, showing no enthusiasm

parts.note: A means one
a path is a way

indicators.note: in a down answer, rising means the word is read upwards

parts.note: to cite is to refer to

explanation.surface: One way of describing a rise that shows no enthusiasm.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone uninterested and indifferent shows no enthusiasm or concern.

clue.text: Play guitar with Cream?

definitions.meaning: the best of a bunch, as in cream of the crop

explanation.definitionFit: One plucks guitar strings, and the choicest of a group is called the best selection.

clue.text: Shocking aberration? Not in such growth areas

indicators.note: the letters are shocked into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, the two letters removed from the pool

explanation.surface: A shocking aberration? Not in the places where things grow.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the letters of 'in' from 'aberration' ('Not in'), then 'Shocking' rearranges the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Arboreta are botanical gardens where trees are grown, the Latin plural form.

clue.text: Take back fruit, omitting starter

indicators.note: the fruit loses its opening letter

parts.note: a greengage is a green plum

explanation.surface: Returning some fruit, but skip the first course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take back' suggests returning goods; here it means to hire again.
explanation.definitionFit: To take staff back on is to rehire or engage them once more.

clue.text: Swedish star shedding old clothes

indicators.note: the star sheds a letter, as one sheds clothes

parts.note: Greta Garbo was a Swedish film star

explanation.surface: A Swedish film star strips off her old outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: Garb is a slightly formal word for clothing or attire.

clue.text: Swell dog turning up with bird

indicators.note: in a down answer, the dog is read upwards

parts.note: Lab is short for Labrador
a loon is a diving bird

explanation.surface: A great dog turning up with a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swell' looks like an adjective, great, but it is the verb to expand.
explanation.definitionFit: To swell out is to inflate or expand like a rubber bag filled with air.

clue.text: Deliver complete collection for nothing

parts.note: a set is a full collection of things
free means costing nothing

explanation.surface: A complete collection is delivered without charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deliver' looks like a courier's job, but it means to rescue or release.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliver someone from captivity is to release them, a liberating sense.

clue.text: Short cut that's found on 23?

definitions.meaning: pebbles found on a seaside strand, the answer to 23 Across

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a cropped hairstyle and the pebbles that cover many British seaside shores.

clue.text: Famous foursome cheerfully evacuated religious office

parts.note: ABBA were the famous Swedish pop quartet

indicators.note: the word is emptied, leaving only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A famous foursome cheerfully abandons a religious post.
explanation.definitionFit: An abbacy is the office or jurisdiction of an abbot.

clue.text: Colour of maiden entering reception room

indicators.note: the maiden goes into the room

parts.note: a salon is a reception room
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: The colour of a young woman entering a drawing room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maiden' suggests a young woman; in cricket a maiden over is M.
explanation.definitionFit: Salmon is a pinkish-orange shade named after the fish's flesh.

clue.text: Blandings Castle butler, Emsworth's first, entertained by composer

indicators.note: the letter is hosted inside the composer

parts.note: J S Bach the composer

indicators.note: only the initial letter of the earl's name is taken

explanation.surface: The Blandings Castle butler and the Earl of Emsworth are hosted by a composer.
explanation.walkthrough: In P G Wodehouse's Blandings stories, Beach is the butler to Lord Emsworth.
explanation.definitionFit: Sebastian Beach is the long-serving butler in Wodehouse's Blandings Castle novels.

clue.text: False bedding material in bed?

parts.note: lying means untruthful
down is the soft feathers used to fill duvets and pillows

explanation.surface: A fake feather filling for one's bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is in bed is reclining, resting horizontally.

clue.text: The man in charge has no right to make a mistake

indicators.note: the boss is without a letter

parts.note: gaffer is informal British for the boss

explanation.surface: The boss has no right to make a blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaffe is a social blunder or tactless error.

clue.text: A jolly vigorous trumpeter

parts.note: a Jolly is old slang for a Royal Marine, RM
strong means vigorous

explanation.surface: A cheerful energetic trumpet player.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jolly' reads as cheerful, but it is a Royal Marine, RM.
explanation.definitionFit: Louis Armstrong was the celebrated American jazz trumpet player.

clue.text: Love goddess following philosopher from the east

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references

indicators.note: in an across answer, reading from the east means right to left

parts.note: A J Ayer was a British philosopher

explanation.surface: A goddess of love comes after a thinker from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'From the east' suggests an oriental thinker, but it reverses AYER.
explanation.definitionFit: Freya is the Norse goddess associated with love and fertility.

clue.text: Principle of Chinese figures in Amnesty International

indicators.note: the letters figure, or appear, inside the phrase

explanation.surface: Chinese principles feature in the work of a human-rights charity.
explanation.definitionFit: In Chinese philosophy the feminine, passive force paired with yang is this dark principle.

clue.text: Criminal freed at once discovers accomplice

indicators.note: the letters behave criminally and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A freed criminal at once gives away his partner in crime.
explanation.definitionFit: A confederate is an ally or associate in a scheme, often an illicit one.
